faqs.question: What website development services do you offer?
faqs.answer: I offer business websites, landing pages, WordPress development, Wix websites, responsive design, and an SEO-friendly website structure.

faqs.question: Which platforms do you build on?
faqs.answer: I build websites on WordPress and Wix.

faqs.question: Will my website be mobile-friendly and SEO-friendly?
faqs.answer: Yes. Responsive design and an SEO-friendly structure are built in from the start.

faqs.question: Can you guarantee more enquiries?
faqs.answer: A website supports your marketing, but results depend on many factors. I focus on a clear structure, user-friendly design and a solid foundation for growth.

faqs.question: How do I get started?
faqs.answer: You can get in touch through my contact form, email, or WhatsApp. We can discuss your requirements and explore the right approach for your business.
